messages:
laura: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — last night's KV-cache OOM. I'm compiling owners + short timeline for remediation. can we do a quick async sync here?

ajay: ive got profiler traces from the canary runs, uploading to the incident doc now: https://redwood/s/INC-2109/trace.zip

mei: saw the same frag pattern in heap histograms — lots of small retired chunks causing fragmentation growth. i think we should try bumping GC headroom + a smaller max_entries to test.

laura: agreed. initial proposals below — want owners so we can push small canary tonight if ok.

laura: ACTIONS (short):
1) Profiling + flamegraphs (owner: mei) — reproduce on staging and attach pprof output to INF-3421. due: 2026-03-27
2) GC/runtime tuning (owner: ajay) — try runtime.gc.percent=200 and investigate ``runtime/debug`` knobs. create PR and canary. due: 2026-03-28
3) KV limits + backpressure (owner: tom) — implement soft cap on kv.cache.max_entries and reject policy under pressure. add metric for "kv_pool_pressure". due: 2026-03-29
4) Observability + alerting (owner: laura) — add alert for "kv_fragmentation_ratio > 0.7" and recurring ramp detection at 02:00 UTC. due: 2026-03-26
5) Postmortem follow-up doc + weekly recurrence review (owner: laura) — add to ops retro agenda. due: 2026-04-02

ajay: quick profiling commands i ran:```sudo perf record -a -g -- sleep 30
pprof --text server.prof > /tmp/pprof.txt
```

mei: i'll take profiling. plan: run the same workload with `kv.cache.max_entries=30M` and `runtime.gc.percent=200`, then compare allocs/heaplive. I'll paste flamegraphs here.

tom: will own the limit guardrail PR. proposed config snippet:```kv.cache.max_entries=40M
kv.cache.reject_policy=soft_pct
kv.cache.soft_pct=85
``` will attach draft PR INF-3421-PR1 and start canary: `deploy --tag canary-kv-frag --route=5%`

infra-bot: deploy started: canary-kv-frag by @tom at 1863000300 — route 5% | sha: b7f4d1a

ajay: fwiw we should also try one-off compaction run in background before we change limits. compaction reduced fragmentation by ~12% in last test. i'll prototype compactor task. owner: ajay-scoped.

laura: noting cross-team: SRE to monitor canary and rollback policy if error rate > 0.5% or p99 latency +50ms.

mei: ETA on my first flamegraphs: EOD today PST. i'll add the pprof blobs to INF-3421 and tag you all.

tom: PR opened: https://redwood/pull/INF-3421-PR1 — includes soft cap + metrics. cc @laura @mei

laura: great. small ask — add a short README in the PR describing expected behavior & measurement plan so the oncall can validate quickly.

tom: will do. done. README added. :thumbsup:

laura: final: i'll update the postmortem follow-up sheet with owners/timestamps and will run a 2-week checklist cadence. if anyone needs to reassign, ping me here. thanks everyone.

ajay: :+1: good plan

mei: thanks — will post flamegraphs in 2–3h

infra-bot: alert: kv_fragmentation_ratio crossed 0.72 on prod-3 at 1863000440 — SRE paging threshold.

laura: noted — SRE, please hold canary if you see error spikes. adding to the incident doc timeline.

tom: looking at metrics now, marking the canary to 0% until SRE gives thumbs up.

laura: updated INF-3421 with next steps and the weekly review slot. Closing async sync, will do a 15m live if alerts persist.

mei: flamegraphs uploaded: https://redwood/s/INF-3421/flamegraphs.zip — initial observation: fragmentation growth correlates with 2x increase in short-lived allocations from dedupe worker.

ajay: that dedupe worker pattern matches what we saw in Jan incidents. adding a recurring ticket INF-3470 to track long-term mitigation (dedupe batching + caching).

laura: perfect. linking INF-3470 and scheduling a follow-up in two weeks. thanks all.
